Please direct traffic accordingly." gtools-ic's briefing came at 18:56Z and proposed the handover. vc routes, at 18:59Z: (1) issue 0073, menuz adopts ArcaMasthead (arca_swift ST0001's WP-04, size S), is utilz-ic's, from gtools-ic's brief at ~/Devel/scratch/gtools-ic/arca/briefs/wp04-menuz.md; (2) gtools-ic stops its wt-wp04 draft, puts Gtools 0106 (WP-05) first, reviews utilz-ic's final diff against the brief, and keeps the macOS 26 one-liner to hv for all four apps; (3) the design goes into 0073 before any source edit, and vc reads it, then the final bytes before the commit; (4) every host run books through gtools-vc (START, GO, END, by SendMessage); (5) cc and dc stay off menuz's files and hold for vc; (6) 0072 stays held until arca_swift's WP-09 lands; (7) the landing is hv's word for the one commit, a push to local only, hv's menuz version number, and a dev install for hv's eye.
